newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello confident on June qtr GDP growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello confident on June qtr GDP growth.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday he was confident economic growth would be above one percent in the June quarter.

Costello told reporters after the release of March quarter national accounts data that a range of factors, including growth in construction and private consumption painted a positive picture for economic growth.
".. for the reasons I have given, you would be very confident of being above one percent for the next quarter," Costello said.
Such growth would give annual growth above three percent, he said.
Australia's seasonally adjusted average gross domestic product, which averages income, expenditure and production measures of GDP, rose 0.9 percent in the March quarter.
Real GDP-A in the year to March rose 2.4 percent.
Most economists had forecast March quarter GDP-A to rise around 0.8 percent, for a year-on-year increase of about 2.2 percent.
